title: Electrical Systems
description: Master all aspects of electrical system installation for electric golf carts. Complete the electrical installation module and pass the comprehensive electrical systems test to earn your electrical certification.

knowledgeChecks.question: When installing a 48V battery system, what is the single most important safety rule?
options: Work as fast as possible to minimize exposure
Always disconnect batteries before working on any electrical component
Use any available tools to save time
It is safe to skip polarity checks if you are experienced
knowledgeChecks.explanation: Disconnecting batteries before any electrical work is the fundamental rule. Even 48V systems can cause serious burns and fires from short circuits or reverse polarity.

knowledgeChecks.question: What should you verify THREE times before making battery connections?
options: The torque setting on the wrench
That your PPE is on correctly
knowledgeChecks.explanation: Polarity must be triple-checked before every battery connection. Reverse polarity WILL cause fire or explosion and destroy expensive components.

knowledgeChecks.question: Which tools must be used when working on live electrical circuits?
options: Insulated tools rated for the voltage
Bare hands are acceptable for low-voltage work
knowledgeChecks.explanation: Insulated tools are required for all electrical work. Non-insulated tools can cause arcing, short circuits, and serious injury even at 48V.
